headline: BSI (BRIS) Posts Profit of Rp6.12 T in Q3-2026, Up 10%
summary: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BRIS) reported third-quarter 2026 net profit of Rp6.12 trillion, up 10% from a year earlier. The report gives no further breakdown.
why: Bank Syariah Indonesia is the country's largest Islamic bank by assets. Its quarterly earnings are a key indicator of Sharia-compliant banking growth in Indonesia.
original_headline: BSI (BRIS) Cetak Laba Rp6,12 T di Kuartal III-2026, Naik 10%
